selection_evidence.selection_statistic: event opportunity count and date breadth only

hypothesis: When high-attention SOL overdelivers relative to a prior-only beta mapping of an abnormal BTC displacement, the excess residual has positive reversal expectancy only after residual compression, opposite SOL aggressive flow and a completed SOL micro-structure shift.

smc_ict_mapping.leader_displacement: completed abnormal BTC return with aligned BTC aggressive flow and activity
smc_ict_mapping.intermarket_smt_overextension: SOL direction-adjusted move at least 1.25 times beta-implied BTC fair move plus 12/18/24 bp excess residual
smc_ict_mapping.attention_regime: prior follower/BTC trade-count ratio at least 1 and prior follower/BTC realized-volatility ratio at least 1.5
smc_ict_mapping.mss_cisd: excess residual compresses at least 25%, opposite SOL flow appears, and SOL breaks the opposite prior 1/3-second micro pivot
smc_ict_mapping.invalidation: most adverse SOL extreme observed through the MSS decision plus 1 bp

fixed_signal.rearm: BTC displacement must remain at or below 25% of the original shock for ten completed 100-ms bins

execution_contract.entry: first actual SOL trade at or after completed MSS plus configured latency
execution_contract.stop: causally observed overreaction extreme plus 1 bp
execution_contract.exit_execution: adverse of the barrier-trigger trade and first post-latency trade for the closing side
execution_contract.source_boundary: unresolved position receives the full stop

top_trade_removal: Identify the largest 10% of positive 12-bp event keys, exclude them before global-slot competition, and rerun the account from initial NAV.
promotion_boundary: This four-day fatal PnL screen is not rank eligible. Any survivor must be expanded under the unchanged rule across broader pre-2024 dates with exact Bybit BBO/depth, funding and capacity before official 2024 can open.
